summary: No box all round (budget pacer, then the 1.2 $/h cap with two other branches' boxes live): no eval, no score. Built and CPU-tested, all off = bit-identical: --auto-beam N [--auto-ge M] (the search -> curriculum loop inside the run; the CPU pre-rent check ran it end to end), beam_tas --start-state / --prop-* / --score pareto (Pareto on field distance x energy height), --demo-success-energy (a curriculum crossing must carry the line's energy). Gate 8 (20.4%): the take-off at 17.46% has ~100 u less energy than the record; local search cannot cross it. The user's first-ramp insight (a field-opposed momentum ramp): uniform GE reaches the half-pipe and pumps +147 u but carries no energy past the start room; the policy does not pump there (it loses energy; the half-pipe has a fatal bottom, *127). Next (box): the energy loop in NOTES - GE line into the ramp -> curriculum -> Pareto beams -> curriculum with --demo-success-energy -> the route loop.
